claims.assertion: Anéeka claims Abu Simbel marked an entrance to an ancient Federation underground base that was flooded during the Aswan Dam project and connected to Giza.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says the base was about 30 meters underground and is now flooded.

review_flags: The source makes an unverified claim about an ancient extraterrestrial base beneath Abu Simbel.
coverage_gaps: The discussion also mentions alleged connections to Crimea and Bucegi and other underground bases.
